verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an AI gateway and observability platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The docs instead stress that integration 'starts monitoring all of your LLM requests', and being able to run the open-source gateway locally is not a documented opt-out control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
